item.title: New date confirmed for trip to Salford City
item.description: Due to Salford City's participation in the fourth round of the Emirates FA Cup, our trip to the Peninsula Stadium will now take place on Tuesday 10th March, kick-off 7.45pm. The fixture was originally scheduled for Saturday 14th February but has been moved as a result of their fixture against Manchester City taking place that day. Tickets for this fixture will go on sale from Monday 16th February, with full details on prices confirmed in due course.

The 23-year-old joined the Saddlers in the summer from League One side Leyton Orient and made 20 appearances in all competitions, with his most recent in our Vertu Trophy Round of 16 clash against Northampton Town. item.title: Head Coach Mat Sadler reflects on point against Chesterfield & previews Bristol Rovers clash
item.description: Head Coach Mat Sadler looked forward to taking on a different challenge on Tuesday night as we travel to the Memorial Stadium to take on Bristol Rovers. The Rovers, now managed by Steve Evans, currently sit 21st in Sky Bet League Two but Sadler ensured that the squad would be fully focused on the match. Walsall come into the game off the back of a 2-2 draw with Chesterfield whilst Bristol Rovers picked up an important victory against Newport County on Saturday. “Another tough game,” Sadler said.
